itens.trecho: Um excelente filme, se bem que a comédia está tão diluída e é tão sarcástica que não tem piada para a maioria das pessoas. Quando vi este filme pela primeira vez, há uns anos atrás, não o entendi e aborreceu-me muito.

An excellent film, although the comedy is so watered down and so sarcastic that it's not funny to most people. When I saw this movie for the first time, a few years ago, I didn't understand it, and it annoyed me a lot.

Saw this again recently for it's anniversary, or 4k conversion, - who cares what the reason was, it was just great to see it up on the bg screen again. In my view, it's easily the best of efforts from both the Coen brothers and from the formidable Frances McDormand.
